framework.name: COSO Enterprise Risk Management Framework
framework.publisher: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission

requirements.title: Exercises board risk oversight
requirements.requirementText: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight of the development and performance of enterprise risk management.

requirements.title: Establishes operating structures
requirements.requirementText: Management establishes operating structures in the context of the entity's objectives and risk appetite, including reporting lines and appropriate authorities and responsibilities.

requirements.title: Defines desired culture
requirements.requirementText: Management defines the entity's desired culture, including risk culture, and evaluates whether it is aligned with the entity's objectives and risk appetite.

requirements.title: Demonstrates commitment to core values
requirements.requirementText: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

requirements.title: Attracts, develops, and retains capable individuals
requirements.requirementText: The organization attracts, develops, and retains capable individuals who have the competence and commitment to carry out their roles in enterprise risk management.

requirements.title: Analyzes business context
requirements.requirementText: The organization analyzes business context, including internal and external factors, to understand the environment in which it operates.

requirements.title: Defines risk appetite
requirements.requirementText: Management defines risk appetite in the context of creating, preserving, and realizing value.

requirements.title: Evaluates alternative strategies
requirements.requirementText: The organization evaluates alternative strategies and considers risk in selecting the strategy.

requirements.title: Formulates business objectives
requirements.requirementText: The organization formulates business objectives that support the selected strategy and considers risk in setting objectives.

requirements.title: Identifies risk
requirements.requirementText: The organization identifies risk affecting the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risk as a basis for determining how it should be managed.

requirements.title: Assesses severity of risk
requirements.requirementText: The organization assesses the severity of risk, including likelihood and impact, to determine which risks are prioritized for management.

requirements.title: Prioritizes risk
requirements.requirementText: The organization prioritizes risks based on their severity and aligns risk responses with the entity's risk appetite.

requirements.title: Implement risk responses
requirements.requirementText: The organization implements risk responses to address identified and assessed risks.

requirements.title: Develops portfolio view
requirements.requirementText: The organization develops a portfolio view of the amount of risk it has assumed.

requirements.title: Assesses substantial change
requirements.requirementText: The organization assesses substantial change that could impact the entity's enterprise risk management.

requirements.title: Assesses ERM
requirements.requirementText: The organization assesses the effectiveness of enterprise risk management and identifies opportunities for improvement.

requirements.title: Reviews risk and performance
requirements.requirementText: The organization reviews risk and performance and considers whether adjustments are needed.

requirements.title: Pursues improvement in ERM
requirements.requirementText: The organization pursues improvement in enterprise risk management.

requirements.title: Leverages information and technology
requirements.requirementText: The organization leverages information and technology to support enterprise risk management.

requirements.title: Communicates risk information
requirements.requirementText: The organization communicates risk information to support the functioning of enterprise risk management.
